A '''needler''' was a type of [[Pistol/Legends|pistol]] designed to penetrate [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shields]] by firing a sharp, tiny [[Dart/Legends|dart]]. The dart could also be laced with contact [[Poison/Legends|poison]], delivering the poison to its targets.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" /> The [[NX-14 Needler/Legends|NX-14]] was a popular model.<ref name="EV" />

A needler cost 650 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and weighed 1 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilogram]]. The needler required an ammunition clip which cost 20 credits and weighed 0.1 kilograms. After 10 shots, the clip must be replaced.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" />

[[Narsk Ka'hane]], a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]], carried a needler with him, which was ideal for spy missions as it did not make the loud noise of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Narsk was able to switch the setting on his needler to fire [[Acid/Legends|acid]]-filled [[Dart/Legends|darts]] or explosive pulse-wave darts. Narsk used this weapon during his initial encounter with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] at the [[Daimanate Dynamic Testing Facility]] without success.<ref name="Knight Errant" />

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[E522 assassin droid/Legends|E522 assassin droid]] was equipped with a neurological needler on their right arm, situated beneath its [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] and [[Heavy repeating blaster/Legends|heavy repeating blaster]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> The weapon fired darts loaded with a [[Neurotoxin/Legends|neurotoxins]].<ref name="SGTD">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
===Non-canon content===
Imperial spy [[Tanya Madera]] used this weapon to administer the deadly [[triflexia]] virus to both [[Chief Technician]] [[Adonar Dellox]] and one of the [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] on [[Reginard Base]]. She later used the weapon to defend herself against a group of Rebels, though she had only five shots left.
